# Project Topic

::: {.callout-note appearance="minimal" title="Project Overview"}
This project provides a comprehensive evaluation of the electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure across all 81 provinces in Türkiye. As the adoption of EVs accelerates, ensuring a balanced, accessible, and sufficient charging network is critical for sustainable mobility. By juxtaposing current infrastructure capacities against localized demand metrics, we aim to uncover regional bottlenecks and highlight areas ripe for future investment.

Our methodology relies on a data-driven, spatial analysis approach using R, integrating three main pillars:

* *Demand Dynamics:* Analyzing the number of registered EVs by city using *TÜİK* data, supplemented by average daily traffic flow and highway density data from *KGM* to understand actual mobility patterns.
* *Supply Capabilities:* Mapping the geographical distribution, socket counts, and power capacities (AC vs. DC) of existing public charging stations using *EPDK* statistics.
* *Spatial & Gap Analysis:* Generating coordinate-based maps and heatmaps to visually identify critical discrepancies where high transit volumes or EV registrations outpace the current charging supply.

Ultimately, this project delivers actionable, data-backed recommendations to optimize the distribution of new charging stations, ensuring the infrastructure meets both current needs and future surges.
:::
